title: LevelsDataStoreV1
description: Schema for Hero level progression (levels 1-30), XP thresholds, stat growth ranges, and unlocked spells.

exp_required.description: Total cumulative experience points required to reach this level.

str_gain.description: Strength stat gain bounds upon reaching this level.

agi_gain.description: Agility stat gain bounds upon reaching this level.

hp_gain.description: Max HP gain bounds upon reaching this level.

mp_gain.description: Max MP gain bounds upon reaching this level.

spell.description: Spell unlocked at this level, if any.
